title: GRADE Scorecard Result
description: Schema for the final scorecard JSON produced by the C9 report generator for one (model × benchmark run). Contains per-task scores, per-track aggregates, per-pack aggregates, and overall scores across all six GRADE dimensions.

result_id.description: Unique identifier for this result record, e.g. a UUID or '<model_slug>-<run_date>-<hash>'.

model_id.description: Fully qualified model identifier matching the model_id in the output records, e.g. 'openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-4-7'.

grade_version.description: Version of the GRADE benchmark package used to produce these scores, e.g. '0.1.0'.

scored_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when scoring completed.

run_count.description: Number of repetitions per (model × task) pair used for consistency scoring. Expected: 5.

task_count.description: Total number of distinct tasks included in this scorecard.

overall_scores.description: Weighted aggregate scores across all tasks and packs. These are the headline numbers reported on the leaderboard.

overall_composite.description: Single composite score [0, 1] computed by applying the project-level dimension weights to overall_scores. Null if not yet computed.

per_track_scores.description: Map from track number (as string key '1'–'5') to dimension scores aggregated over all tasks in that track.

per_pack_scores.description: Map from pack identifier to dimension scores aggregated over all tasks run against that pack.

per_task_scores.description: One entry per (task_id) with that task's dimension scores and aggregate.

cost_metrics.description: Optional aggregate API cost, token counts, and latency statistics for the full benchmark run. Absent when no adapter reported any runtime metadata.

DimensionScores.description: Scores for each of the six GRADE scoring dimensions. All values are in [0, 1].

grounding_accuracy.description: Grounding Accuracy score [0, 1]. Project weight: 35%. Fraction of gold_facts asserted correctly and no forbidden_claims present.

insight_quality.description: Insight Quality score [0, 1]. Project weight: 20%. Coverage and depth of gold_insights reached.

evidence_linkage.description: Evidence Linkage score [0, 1]. Project weight: 15%. Fraction of key claims explicitly tied to source data.

calibration_limitation_handling.description: Calibration & Limitation Handling score [0, 1]. Project weight: 15%. Coverage of required_limitations and absence of overconfident claims.

consistency.description: Consistency score [0, 1]. Project weight: 10%. Agreement of key findings across 5 repeated runs.

structure_usability.description: Structure & Usability score [0, 1]. Project weight: 5%. Practitioner-facing format quality.

TrackResult.description: Aggregated scores for one benchmark track.

track_name.description: Human-readable track name, e.g. 'Grounded Retrieval & Computation'.

task_count.description: Number of tasks included in this track's aggregate.

composite.description: Track-level composite score applying project-level weights to dimension scores.

PackResult.description: Aggregated scores for one fixture pack.

task_count.description: Number of tasks run against this pack.

CostMetrics.description: Aggregate API cost, token counts, and latency for the benchmark run. Fields are null/false when the adapter or provider does not report them.

total_cost_usd.description: Sum of per-call cost_usd across all runs and tasks. Null when no call reported cost (cost_available=false).

cost_available.description: True if at least one model call in this run reported a non-null cost_usd.

cost_partial.description: True when cost data was present for some calls but missing for others (mixed adapter/provider situation).

total_prompt_tokens.description: Sum of prompt_tokens across all runs and tasks. 0 when tokens are not reported.

total_completion_tokens.description: Sum of completion_tokens across all runs and tasks. 0 when tokens are not reported.

tokens_available.description: True if at least one model call reported non-null token counts.

mean_latency_ms.description: Mean wall-clock latency in milliseconds across all model calls. Null if no outputs.

p50_latency_ms.description: Median (p50) latency in milliseconds. Null if no outputs.

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum latency in milliseconds across all model calls. Null if no outputs.

cost_usd.description: Total cost for this task across all runs. Null when not reported.

prompt_tokens.description: Total prompt tokens for this task across all runs.

completion_tokens.description: Total completion tokens for this task across all runs.

mean_latency_ms.description: Mean latency in ms for this task across all runs. Null if no runs.

TaskResult.description: Scores for a single task, averaged over all repetition runs.

task_id.description: Task identifier matching the task definition.

pack_id.description: Fixture pack this task was evaluated against.

run_count.description: Number of repetition runs included in these aggregated scores.

scorer_flags.description: Optional list of scorer warning flags, e.g. ['low_n_subgroup_skipped', 'numeric_tolerance_applied'].
